entities.summary: Kenelm Edward Lee Guinness MBE was a British racing driver of the 1910s and 1920s mostly associated with Sunbeam racing cars. He set a new Land Speed Record in 1922. Also an automotive engineer, he invented and manufactured the KLG spark plug. Additionally, aside from motorsport and mechanical interests, he was a director of the Guinness brewing company. Kenelm Lee Guinness was a performers & entertainers from London (1887-08-14, London–1937-04-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
